featured_reviews.name: Amod Dalvi
featured_reviews.review_text: The variety on offer and the quality and taste of the food is top notch. Pankaj Sir provided great recommendations throughout the process of finalising the wedding menu. Every guest lauded the food quality and taste which made it all worthwhile. Their team is also very attentive and took good care of our guest needs. Pankaj Sir and his team also accomodated many of our requests and last minute capacity increases very well, without any inconveniences. Would highly recommend to anyone without a single hesitation.

featured_reviews.name: Vibhor Badri
featured_reviews.review_text:
Choosing Ekveera Caterers for our wedding reception on 1st Feb 2026, was one of the best decisions we made.

From day one, we felt a very personal connection. The proprietor Mr. Pankaj Gupte gave us genuine, one-on-one attention and never rushed us through decisions. During the tasting sessions, they spent so much time helping us explore options, refine the menu, and build a spread that truly reflected us and our guests and that too, at a very very competitive price. It never felt transactional — it felt collaborative.

What impressed us deeply was the value they delivered. We received what honestly felt like premium service without cutting any corners. If anything, the quality during the reception exceeded even our expectations. The food was fresh, beautifully prepared, and consistently excellent throughout the evening — something our guests are still talking about.

A very heartfelt mention to Mr. Pankaj Gupte. During an unexpected medical emergency at the event, along with Govindmani Lawns staff, he stepped in immediately and supported us without hesitation. In that stressful moment, his calm presence and help meant more than we can express. That kind of humanity goes far beyond catering.

Ekveera Caterers didn’t just serve food at our reception — they stood by us and contributed to making one of the most important days of our lives truly memorable.

We will be forever thankful to them. ❤️

featured_reviews.name: Sanjay Shelke
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely delighted to avail the services from M/S Ekveera - Shri Pankaj Gupte . This was during a family  wedding followed by a reception of over a thousand guests. The grandeur of the event was certainly contributed by the food , selection , quality , hygiene and service. It was always a comfortable feeling to deal with Mr Gupte who is an expert ,professional,  calm and extremely polite . I admire my own decision to select m/ s Ekveera among the host of choices available.

Strongly recommended .

The menu selection , the options were prepared especially for our testing , discussed and guided through . Chat items were served in mineral water and other food was so delicious and lighter that the guests fully enjoyed both morning and evening menus .

The live counters and intercontinental dishes alongwith very premium dessert added to the charm of the evening.

The costs were reasonable and the value that was offered is intangible.

featured_reviews.name: tejas save
featured_reviews.review_text:
I personally recommend Ekveera Caterers.
Right from day one, Pankaj Gupte provided many helpful suggestions for menu combinations and ensured that the food matched our preferences perfectly. Their idea of including Bhajni che wade with chicken masala turned out to be an excellent choice. Our guests truly appreciated the food, and even the elders on our guest list gave full marks to their dishes.
The food was not only delicious but also served with great care and professionalism. Every item was well-prepared, fresh, and flavorful. Overall, Ekveera Caterers made our day memorable with their outstanding service and mouthwatering menu.

featured_reviews.name: Gaurav Madav
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently used Ekveera Catering Services for our event, and I am delighted to share our positive experience. The food was absolutely delicious, with a great variety of options that pleased all our guests. Every dish was fresh, flavourful, and beautifully presented.
The service was equally impressive. The staff was professional, attentive and ensured everything ran smoothly from start to finish. They were prompt in setting up, responsive to our needs throughout the event and handled everything with a smile.
I highly recommend them to anyone looking for high quality food and excellent service for their next event.
Thank you again for making our occasion so special.

featured_reviews.name: Ninad Ghag
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently hired Ekveera caterers for our daughter’s first birthday, and I couldn’t be happier with our choice. Right from the first call, the team was professional, responsive, and genuinely interested in understanding our needs.

The food itself was fantastic — fresh, delicious, and beautifully presented. Our guests especially loved the live counters. The menu was thoughtfully curated for both kids and adults, which made everyone feel included and well-fed.

What truly impressed me was their attention to detail: timely setup, courteous staff, and the way they managed everything seamlessly so we could just focus on enjoying the day with family and friends.

A huge thank you to Ekveera Catering Services for making our daughter’s special day even more memorable. Highly recommend them for anyone looking for hassle-free, quality catering!

featured_reviews.name: Harsh Wagle
featured_reviews.review_text:
They told us 1kg of sheera is 550. We asked for half a kilo and when the delivery guy came here came without a bill so we couldn't know how much he charged. After we ate he came back and charged for a full kilo. We told him we got only half kilo, now he says that half a kilo is 550 now. The problem is that the cost of it is not written anywhere on the menu but for some reason my brother still bought it because he actually liked the food here. So we fought, they fought, we got irritated and paid. They lost a customer over a sheera lol. I dont care as much about the money, but I do dislike these scammy practices.

The sheera was nothing special, sadly.

Loved the food.  Thank you Annadeep.
